objective: Test whether Jev adds useful source-supported evidence of paid software operating changes at lower total research cost; this is a feasibility experiment, not an alpha backtest.

source_license.research_context: Private bounded technical evaluation of source access and model interpretation. Do not deploy a commercial Scry dependency or export a substantial corpus.
source_license.production_fallback: Permitted original public APIs and original linked engineering posts. No bulk reconstruction of Scry's corpus.

selection: Deterministic hash order of source-native IDs within vendor/source/date strata; product mentions only, no action-word or score filter. Merge duplicate native IDs and exact normalized bodies. Keep unfilled source/vendor quotas without substitutions.
split_unit: Connected components sharing a source thread or exact normalized body; deterministic component hash assigns development or evaluation before model calls.
execution: Research and paper accounting only. Future manual Schwab tickets require a separately frozen financial protocol and verified security mappings. No order API.
interpretation_limits: A source-supported report is not independent verification of the author's claim or vendor revenue.
Source creation time does not prove the current text existed at that time; date-only capture metadata cannot justify an intraday entry.
Reddit's partial live tail is not volume-comparable to its reconciled historical archive.
Many records, comments or questions about one customer migration remain one economic episode.
No stock-return forecasts, current ticker eligibility claims, or calibrated trade probabilities follow from this screen.
